changes.shows: Six short horizontal marks occupy the name space. No letter remnants occur between them; this is a blank name represented by dashes, not physically unreadable writing.
Each end has paired upright quote strokes, with no sideways chevrons. The grave on è is visible.

changes.place: n over the two opening tensor signs
changes.shows: Both n letters are centered directly above their tensor cells, rather than sitting after them as right superscripts. The crossed O-like typed construction is visible at both positions.

Inside the u cell an additional r stem and hooked upper shoulder remain visible. A separate short horizontal underline lies below the following r, not below the whole word. No independent strike cancels the overlapped r.
The canceled final cell retains an e bowl, middle bar and lower opening under the x strike. It is not a live extra e and the s alternative is excluded.

changes.final: \unsure{intersect°|intersect.} avec A^+ after noyau, with leader
changes.shows: The word is abbreviated: the small raised final mark remains ambiguous between a degree-like contraction and a point. The curved leader descends into the gap immediately after noyau and rises to the right of A-positive, so the insertion is placed there and the leader is reproduced.

changes.shows: The upright crop shows cela, then e-n-t-r-a-i-n-e. The i carries a simple dot with blank paper around it, no circumflex. The words are readable.

changes.place: last word of upper marginal question
changes.shows: The initial a-n-t-i, descending p, round o, ascending d and final i-s-m-e sequence remain distinguishable after rotation; the question mark is separate. C doubt resolved.
The inserted typewritten words stand above the gap after coalgèbre and before à degrés. The acute on the final e meets the lowered m of Filt above it.
The s reverse curves are visible beneath the x cancellation immediately before 0.
The typed sur k sits above the gap between diagonal and unitaire. A curved line descends at that gap and curls upward to the right of k; both text and leader are reproduced.
The punctuation has a dark upper head and a distinct descending pointed tail. It is a comma rather than a round full stop. C doubt resolved.

The open ellipse carries a nearly horizontal middle stroke; two crossing diagonals cannot be separated at maximum zoom. The barred-circle appearance is recorded first and a compressed tensor remains possible.
The open loop has faint short interior strokes clustered at the lower left. They suggest a compressed cross but do not securely exclude a single bar.
The flattened loop has a prominent oblique-to-horizontal bar. A second crossing stroke cannot be isolated from the thick lower edge.

changes.C: live A tensor M to M comp. avec application diagonale
changes.shows: The complete second line is written without an independent horizontal or diagonal cancellation stroke. The connecting letters and the closing parenthesis remain live.

changes.place: initial mark in outlined marginal note
changes.shows: One long slanted stem ends in a closed lower loop. There is no second stem for Il. The mark is 6-like but b cannot be excluded.
After m-e the two short tall strokes are followed by a distinct point. There is no r-e continuation. C doubt is resolved in favor of the abbreviation.

changes.place: last two lines of outlined note
changes.shows: The upper line reads compatible aux; the lower reads c-o-u-n-i-t-é-s with a visible acute. No hyphen separates co and unités, and the exclamation mark follows. The ink does not read H associativity clause.
A long top curve runs into the right boundary, then curves left below the words; the left side remains open. C drawing retains this shape, while H only describes it.
Both ends have paired upright strokes, with no angle marks. The acute on unité is present.

changes.place: first letter and underwritten M in l-image
changes.shows: The first typed glyph has the top-left serif and bottom foot of lowercase l, not the two full-height strokes of a capital L. A plain M is typed directly below it and is not canceled.

changes.final: same insertion with sloping curved leader
changes.shows: The e with lowered M stands above the gap after image. A rising S-like line begins in that gap and ends above-right of the inserted letters; it is reproduced in TikZ.
The hand sign has a single C-shaped outer curve with a straight middle bar, not the two opposed curves of varepsilon. C doubt resolved. The lowered M, e_M and right-hand 1 are clear.

changes.place: looped trace over e in que
changes.final: e with qualified looped trace reproduced in TikZ
changes.shows: A narrow dark loop rises above the e and continues as a short upright through its upper bowl. The trace is drawn as seen without calling it a particular letter or assigning a correction history. Its meaning remains uncertain.

The left-pointing head and one wavy stroke above the shaft are clear. The heavily worked right end contains an apparent covered arrowhead; it is not possible to decide whether the right head remains live. C alternatives retained, with left arrow first.
A rounded top, heavy crossbar and long left downstroke remain visible. Heavy retracing obscures whether the extended left stroke belongs to a calligraphic form; C qualification retained.

changes.C: triangle with both legs diagonal and sim
changes.shows: The left descending leg points toward barred M, while the right leg is drawn almost vertically down. Above the horizontal left-pointing arrow there is one wavy stroke, not the two strokes of approx. The diagram uses the observed vertical right leg and single sim label.
The terminal letter after the tall crossed t is a short open e-like return with no enclosed a bowl. C e/a doubt is resolved in favor of e.
A curved upper hook, descending stem and separate lower dot stand in the left margin next to the diagram.
The typed letter stands above the baseline. A left curved branch descends to the insertion point and a long oblique right branch rises beside the letter; the two-branch leader is reproduced in TikZ.
The typed letter stands above the baseline. A left curved branch descends to the insertion point and a long oblique right branch rises beside the letter; the two-branch leader is reproduced in TikZ.

The left terminal bar and horizontal shaft are clear. The right tip is a compact rounded blot without two separable arrowhead arms. C alternatives remain; the adjacent g-arrow does have a clear right head.

The cell has upper serifs at capital height and a second pair at lowercase height, with a lower u-like terminal foot. These are overlapping unlike typed impressions, not a securely identifiable blackboard alphabet. Both U and u are retained without inferring order.
The typed phrase sits above est injectif. Its leader descends immediately after the preceding e and curls up after the inserted M.
Each hand quote has two short upright strokes joined near the lower end. They are double quotes rather than a single apostrophe or guillemets.
The isolated dash has the same short width as the internal hyphen in parait-il. The i of parait has a dot and no circumflex; both witnesses retain that spelling.
